objective: Test whether the frozen V2.8.4 18-term lexical discovery gate misses historical filings that satisfy the unchanged AI-Core E classifier, without modifying the completed V2.9 source-expansion result or consuming outcome data.

problem_elimination_pass.delete: Do not rerun the 730-day 18-term census and do not add synonyms merely to chase the 12-security floor.
problem_elimination_pass.avoid: Use an issuer-scoped announcement path with blank lexical searchkey so candidate visibility does not depend on any AI keyword registry.
problem_elimination_pass.absorb: Reuse the already-frozen fold0/fold1/fold2 identities, temporal provenance, PDF extraction and page-scoped AI-Core classifier.
problem_elimination_pass.substitute: Test existence of lexical false negatives directly instead of optimizing keyword precision or recall first.
problem_elimination_pass.precompute_reuse: Reuse the frozen 2023-2024 calendar, manifest bindings and the parent run artifact as immutable comparison authority.
problem_elimination_pass.optimize: Only after the probe establishes whether lexical false negatives exist may a separate discovery redesign be preregistered.

invariants.temporal_rule: Asia/Shanghai announcement date must equal official finalpage path date; effective date is first frozen joint A-share session strictly after disclosure date.

probe_design.transport_hypothesis: CNINFO issuer-scoped historical announcement queries can enumerate an issuer's 2023-2024 filings with searchkey blank, so visibility is independent of the frozen 18-term lexical registry.
probe_design.transport_precedent: scripts/v2729_primary_locator_inventory.py already uses issuer-scoped CNINFO queries with searchkey blank for periodic filing retrieval; V2.9.1 must independently validate the exact transport before production use.

phase_a_transport_validation.purpose: Validate blank-searchkey issuer-scoped pagination, identity binding, date bounds and official locator integrity on deterministic fixtures before the scientific probe.

probe_design.security_order: All fold0/fold1/fold2 canonical_security_id values sorted by SHA256(canonical_security_id), then canonical_security_id; no manual or sector ordering.
probe_design.document_order_within_security: Official disclosure date ascending, then announcement_id ascending.
probe_design.candidate_scope: Issuer-scoped official CNINFO filings inside the frozen disclosure range, retrieved with blank searchkey and no AI lexical term. Apply frozen title triage; dedupe by announcement_id.
probe_design.lexical_negative_space_definition: A probe filing is negative-space only when its announcement_id is absent from the complete deduped candidate-id universe produced by the parent V2.9 18-term census artifact.
probe_design.classification_input: Official PDF page text only; search result title/snippet is never classifier evidence.

bounded_execution.continue_rule: Execute batches in frozen order until the first batch containing at least one classifier-ready negative-space ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE filing is completed, or all four batches are completed.
bounded_execution.reason: This is an existence/root-cause probe, not an information-floor rescue run; bounded sequential execution avoids a second full-market historical census.

probe_design.comparison: For every negative-space positive, record canonical_security_id, development_fold, announcement_id, disclosure date, effective date, official locator, PDF hash, evidence page, evidence-sentence hash, classifier decision hash, and proof of absence from the parent 18-term candidate-id universe.

H2_DISCOVERY_SELECTION_BIAS.support_condition: At least one classifier-ready ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE filing is found in lexical negative space with valid identity and temporal provenance.
H2_DISCOVERY_SELECTION_BIAS.interpretation: Directly proves the frozen 18-term lexical retrieval gate has false-negative recall for the unchanged AI-Core E definition. It does not prove that a redesigned discovery system would satisfy the 20/12/12/6/max20% information floor.

H1_REAL_SCARCITY.support_condition: No negative-space ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE filing is found after all four preregistered 64-security batches complete with adequate technical coverage.
H1_REAL_SCARCITY.interpretation: Increases evidence for real scarcity within this deterministic 256-security probe only; it does not establish full-universe scarcity.

forbidden: No modification of the completed V2.9 source-expansion evidence or terminal TOO_SPARSE result.
No addition, removal, stemming, synonym expansion or reweighting of the frozen 18 discovery terms inside this probe.
No classifier, triage, temporal-rule or information-floor change.
No security or document selection based on observed AI evidence, positive yield, sector intuition or desired information-floor outcome.
No price, return, benchmark, transaction-cost, strategy, candidate-outcome, live or brokerage data.
No reopening or expansion of V2.8.12R.
No claim of V2.9 READY from this diagnostic probe even if false negatives are found.
